description: Native HumMod diagnostic probe to isolate low-minute-ventilation hypercapnia while minimizing early hypoxic collapse. Not a clinical ventilation regimen and not Berlin ARDS calibration.

provenance.purpose: Test native HumMod chronotropic/autonomic response to severe hypoventilation with oxygen protection so hypercapnia can develop before hypoxic terminal failure.
limitations: 100% inspired oxygen is used to delay hypoxic collapse and is not intended as a clinical treatment recommendation.
Native HumMod ventilator does not expose PEEP.
